lines.zh: 斧头挂在肩后，我踩着木板走。
lines.en: Axe slung behind my shoulder, I walk the planks.
The deck boards groan under me. Let them.
I walk the wharf toward the camp.

lines.zh: 盾上的漆掉了，我不在乎。
lines.en: The paint is off my shield. I do not care.

lines.zh: 木板路下面是水，我走得很稳。
lines.en: Water under the planks, and I walk steady.

lines.zh: 我绕过那堆篝火，往北去。
lines.en: I round the fire pit and head north.

lines.zh: 走一步，斧柄就撞一下腰带。
lines.en: Each step knocks the axe haft against my belt.
I pass the longhouse door.
My stride is longer than theirs.
I hum a tune on my way to the anchorage.
I hone the axe edge and sparks fly.
Sitting on the prow, I watch the grey sea.

lines.zh: 我把盾靠在腿上，喘口气。
lines.en: I rest the shield on my knee and catch my breath.

lines.zh: 战利品堆在脚边，还没分。
lines.en: The plunder is piled at my feet, undivided.
I count the scars along the gunwale.
The wind bends the fire sideways.
I lick my cracked lip.

lines.zh: 有人唱歌，我听着，没跟着。
lines.en: Someone is singing. I listen without joining.

lines.zh: 我盯着海平线，那里什么都没有。
lines.en: I stare at the horizon. Nothing there.

lines.zh: 斧柄上缠的皮条又松了。
lines.en: The leather wrap on my haft has come loose again.
The longhouse fire is burning low.

lines.zh: 我把头盔摘下来，放在膝上。
lines.en: I take off my helm and set it on my knee.

lines.zh: 背上的旧伤天一冷就疼。
lines.en: The old wound in my back aches in the cold.

lines.zh: 我捏着一枚异乡的银币。
lines.en: I turn a foreign silver coin in my fingers.

lines.zh: 雪落在斧刃上，很快就化。
lines.en: Snow lands on the axe edge and melts at once.

lines.zh: 我咳了一声，喉咙里全是烟。
lines.en: I cough; my throat is full of smoke.
Outlander, where is your ship?
You do not smell of iron.

lines.zh: 站远一点，我的斧子很长。
lines.en: Stand back. My axe has reach.
Can your god stop my axe?

lines.zh: 看你的眼睛，你不像懦夫。
lines.en: Your eyes say you are no coward.
What did you bring to buy your life?
This shore belongs to us now.

lines.zh: 我不问你名字，只问你带了几个人。
lines.en: I do not ask your name, only how many came with you.
What you hold is too light.
Say something. Do not just stand there.
That is a strange smile.

lines.zh: 你走路的姿势像打过仗。
lines.en: You walk like a man who has fought.

lines.zh: 这一下砍进了我的手臂。
lines.en: That cut went into my arm.
I spat blood and cursed.
I grin. That was a scratch.
My leg gave, and I braced on the shield.
Whoever bloodied me will pay.
A split has opened in my shield.
The haft has numbed my palm.

lines.zh: 我撕下一块布缠紧伤口。
lines.en: I tear a strip of cloth and bind the wound.

lines.zh: 斧柄上还沾着营地的木屑。
lines.en: Camp wood shavings cling to my axe.

lines.zh: 这一斧差点砍断我的腿。
lines.en: That blow nearly took my leg.
Whose barrel of mead is that?
Roast smoke is drifting to the camp gate.
I have lowered the axe halfway.
One drink first, then we talk.

lines.zh: 那锅汤的味道让我停了脚。
lines.en: That pot of stew stopped me in my tracks.
My belly drums like a war horn.
Whoever is grilling fish, save me one.

lines.zh: 甜的东西，我已经很久没尝。
lines.en: Sweet things. It has been long.

lines.zh: 酒坛一开，我的眼就直了。
lines.en: A tapped cask and my eyes fix.
Bowl in hand, I drink to you first.

lines.zh: 撞我不疼，撞我的斧就疼。
lines.en: Bumping me is fine. Bumping my axe is not.
Do you think you can move me?
Out of the way, outlander.
My shield is harder than your skull.
Get your footing. This wharf is slick.
Shoulder to shoulder, and I laugh.
Stop shoving or the planks will flip.
You are standing on my plunder.
That knock shook you too.
If we fight, we fight on land.
She sits at the far end of the longhouse.

lines.zh: 她把我的斧子擦得发亮。
lines.en: She polishes my axe until it shines.
We traded arm rings.
She says I stay out at sea too long.

lines.zh: 炉火边，她的头发是红的。
lines.en: By the hearth her hair is red.
I promised her no long voyage this time.
My scars do not frighten her.

lines.zh: 两把斧子挂在同一面墙上。
lines.en: Two axes hang on the same wall.

lines.zh: 我们的孩子会先学划桨。
lines.en: Our child will learn the oar first.

lines.zh: 她把蜜酒倒进两只角杯。
lines.en: She pours mead into two horns.
This iron nail will patch the boat.
A good stone for the axe.
I pick up a fallen shield ring.
This cloak on the ground is still wearable.
The coin is mine. Your life stays yours.
I gather the broken oar.

lines.zh: 这个角杯缺了口，还能用。
lines.en: This horn is chipped but usable.
Half a dried fish. Down it goes.
I coil the rope end at my waist.
Found things go in the sack first.
Someone is running over there.
I can see his shield now.
He is alone. Perfect.
He has turned his back to me.
I tighten my grip on the haft.
There is iron on that one.

lines.zh: 风把声音送过来，我听见了。
lines.en: The wind carries his sound. I hear it.
The mark is past the rocks.

lines.zh: 我慢慢往前走，不惊动他。
lines.en: I advance slowly so he is not startled.
He has looked up and seen me.

lines.zh: 一次就够，我不需要第二次。
lines.en: One blow will do. I need no second.

lines.zh: 他停下来了，这是他的错。
lines.en: He stopped. That was his mistake.
I count the paces between us.
The axe edge points his way.
That sword of his is too short.

lines.zh: 我笑了，他也看见我笑了。
lines.en: I grin, and he sees the grin.

lines.zh: 海风帮我把气味吹散了。
lines.en: The sea wind hides my scent.

lines.zh: 他退后一步，我进了两步。
lines.en: He gives a step; I take two.
He hops between the rocks.
I follow him without hurry.
He is panting hard. I can hear it.
I want him tired before I move.

lines.zh: 斧柄在我手里转了一圈。
lines.en: The haft turns once in my hand.
He throws a stone. I do not dodge.
He cannot circle out of this one.
I keep my eyes on his knees.
The hand on his sword is shaking.
The snow will keep his footprints.

lines.zh: 他往船那边退，正合我意。
lines.en: He backs toward the boats. Good.

lines.zh: 他跑，我把斧子换到左手。
lines.en: He runs, and I shift the axe to my left hand.
He shouted something. The wind ate it.
At this range one axe swing arrives.
His torch is nearly out.
I wait for his foot to sink in the mud.
He holds still. So do I.
Slowly I raise the axe.
He backs to the water. No road left.
One more step. Just one.
The axe comes down from above.
My shield knocks his blade aside.
This swing bites into his shield.
The haft sweeps across his ribs.

lines.zh: 他挡了第一下，没挡住第二下。
lines.en: He stopped the first. Not the second.
I shoulder in and he gives ground.
The axe's back crushes his pauldron.
I pin his shield under my boot.
The axe comes with the wind behind it.
He raises an arm; I cut the arm.

lines.zh: 这一下把他掀翻在雪里。
lines.en: This one flips him into the snow.
I roar. He roars back.

lines.zh: 斧刃擦着他的喉咙过去。
lines.en: The edge passes his throat.

lines.zh: 我抓住他的领口往下拉。
lines.en: I grab his collar and haul him down.

lines.zh: 他的剑卡在我的盾沿上。
lines.en: His sword jams on my shield rim.
My knee drives into his belly.

lines.zh: 船靠岸了，我第一个跳下来。
lines.en: The ship grounds and I am first over the side.

lines.zh: 我把斧子从船板上拔起来。
lines.en: I pull the axe out of the deck boards.
The wind ashore is colder than at sea.
We rowed in out of the fog.
I step onto the sand; my prints go deep.

lines.zh: 长屋的门被我一脚踢开。
lines.en: One kick and the longhouse door is open.
I have brought fresh plunder.
The fleet rests on the shallows.

lines.zh: 我把盾举起来，让他们看见。
lines.en: I raise my shield so they see it.
There will be fire in this camp tonight.
The shore is empty. Their misfortune.
My boots are still wet.

lines.zh: 我跺了跺脚，雪掉下来了。
lines.en: I stamp my feet and snow falls off.

lines.zh: 号角吹了三声，我们上了岸。
lines.en: Three blasts of the horn and we landed.

lines.zh: 我从船头走到船尾，再走到岸上。
lines.en: From prow to stern and down onto the shore.

lines.zh: 第一次踏这片土，我记下了。
lines.en: First time on this soil. I have marked it.

lines.zh: 远山后面还有更多的岸。
lines.en: There are more shores beyond those hills.

lines.zh: 我把斧子扛在肩上，往前走。
lines.en: Axe on my shoulder, I walk inland.
I tie the line to the post.
I light the longhouse fire first.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的胡子，我拍打。
lines.en: Fire caught my beard and I swat at it.

lines.zh: 我从桅杆上掉下来，砸在甲板。
lines.en: I fell from the mast onto the deck.
A wave pressed down and I swallowed seawater.

lines.zh: 那声炸响把我掀进沙里。
lines.en: The blast threw me into the sand.
An arrow stands in my shoulder.
That force unsteadied my feet.
No food aboard. I have thinned out.

lines.zh: 雷打在斧上，我的手麻了。
lines.en: Lightning struck the axe and numbed my hand.

lines.zh: 脚下没有底，我一直往下。
lines.en: There is no bottom under me. I keep falling.
